abstract.t: The Intelligent Agent Markup Language (IaML) is a linear, zero-copy, compute-efficient structural serialization syntax designed for high-density communication between Intelligent Agents (IA), edge parsers, and local or distributed inference engines. By replacing nested, recursive tree structures (such as JSON and XML) with colon-delimited Dot.Case tags and explicit 'e'-prefixed buffer closure traps, IaML enables O(n) single-pass stream routing, deterministic partitioning between cognitive and control channels, and bounded domain extensibility without secondary parsing trees.
